claims.text: Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "Antigravity for Aerospace Applications", series "Acquisition Threat Support", published 2010-03-30 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2009-12-01, DIA document number DIA-08-1003-018. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.
Released PDF is 44 pages, marked UNCLASSIFIED//FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY (FOUO caveat partially illegible in the scan).
Authored by Dr Eric Davis of EarthTech International, per the 9 January 2018 DIA list (item 11).
Cover page reads "30 March 2010 / ICOD: 1 December 2009 / DIA-08-1003-018", series "Acquisition Threat Support".

claims.text: EarthTech International's own publication list independently records the document as: Davis, E. W. (2010), "Antigravity for Aerospace Applications", Defense Intelligence Reference Document, Acquisition Threat Support, DIA-08-1003-018, Acquisition Support Division (DWO-3), Defense Warning Office, Directorate for Analysis, Defense Intelligence Agency, Washington, DC. This is the author's own attribution and matches the DIA list and the cover page exactly.

Davis is credited with six of the 38 DIRDs on the DIA list, more than any other author: antigravity, traversable wormholes, quantum vacuum energy extraction, laser lightcraft nanosatellites, quantum tomography of negative energy states, and (with R. Obousy) warp drive and extra dimensions.
